content: Client-side-only paywalls (hiding already-downloaded content via CSS/JS state) are trivially bypassed by disabling JavaScript, editing localStorage/React state in devtools, or reading page source/network responses, because the protected content was already delivered to the browser before the check ran. Industry-standard approach for real paywalls is server-side entitlement resolution: the server checks the user's subscription/entitlement record before ever including the gated content in an API response or server-rendered HTML, so unauthorized clients never receive the payload at all, not just a hidden version of it.
